text.content:
Instrument Types, Properties, and Effects are ordinary Items in the FOIL Vocabulary compendiums. Content refers to them by slug, so creating a new one in a world makes it available on every sheet at once.

  • Instrument Type or Property: whether it is a Type or a Property, its family, what it harms, and flags for Quick, Reload, and Tools.
  • Property: a passive Equipment Property, Resistance +N, +N to a Skill, or Aid +N.
  • Effect: how it prices, which Types can deliver it, and whether it counts toward the combination premium.

A Technique's XP is priced from its Effects (PHB 4.2.1), and the sheet shows the computed price beside the printed one.

  1. Sum the Effects. Stress is an Effect at 4 XP.
  2. A Pattern, Selective, or Extend Range is priced by Range and counts as an Effect.
  3. Add 4 XP for every Effect beyond the first. Quick and Upkeep don't count; Upkeep costs a flat 4 XP and Quick 3.
  4. A Technique that aims only at allies or its user, a ward or bonus lasting 1 round or longer, or a Quick trigger costs at least 8 XP.
  5. A Sonic Technique with a Condition adds 8 XP for its reach (PHB 4.2.4).
  6. Strain is floor((XP - 24) / 8), never below 0. A Selective Technique, or a Sonic Technique with a Condition, takes its Strain from its XP less the 8 XP charge.

Beam or Wall costs 1 + 2 + ... per rung of the Range ladder (Range 1, 2, 4, 8, 20); a Cone 3x that, a Radius 12x. Selective costs N + (R x N).

Base price by weight class: Light 15p, Medium 30p, Heavy 45p. Each Property other than Tools and Immobile adds 10p. Reach past the usual Range adds 10p a band (PHB 5.2.2).

A +N bonus adds by the item's size, and grants +N to rolls. A Melee or Ranged Instrument also gets Pierce equal to half the bonus, rounded down. A Guarding Instrument's +N also adds to the Oppose it guards.
